controls.evidence: Exact-slot Alchemy Account Archive reads at finalized Solana slot 457200000 (2026-10-15T10:13:19Z; block hash CkfH8u58XAk7qq4cQAuGFuJn8VkdXYGhN39wSRHQKN8Y) retain mintAuthority UuicDY26j4dUf5QraXJ99PwPzGwZjRWZmnxcyMhJAgk, decimals 6 and total issued supply 8,177,042 ZARsc. The authority is nonexecutable, zero-data and System Program owned, not an SPL multisig or PDA. Token-2022 minting has no issuer-authored numeric supply cap to raise and no code-enforced time delay. The same signer holds mint-close and metadata-update authority; closing a mint requires zero supply. Transfer restrictions, fee and interest-display controls do not create additional native mint authorities and are inventoried in the blacklistability review. Pinned getTransaction at slot 361067527 (2025-08-19T09:09:10Z) confirms successful creation and initialization of the exact mint.

review.evidence: The sole native Solana mint authority and all configured extension authorities were re-read through Alchemy's exact-slot Account Archive at finalized slot 457200000 (2026-10-15T10:13:19Z). All four authority accounts are nonexecutable, zero-data System Program accounts. Fireblocks and issuer disclosures bind MPC custody to ZARsc issuance, but do not disclose beneficial human operators, independent organizational approvals or an on-chain quorum or delay. Token-2022 is the standard governing program rather than an issuer-authored upgradeable proxy; the immutable classification describes that issuer-local mint-code boundary, not immutability of Solana's shared token program or a prohibition on the migration reserved by terms section 12.2. Moore's July 31 and August 31 monthly AUP reports reconcile the exhaustive native Solana token-account population to total issued supply, then compare circulation after management-designated treasury exclusions with independently obtained Absa reserve balances for Super Money SA (Pty) Ltd. The July report was signed August 18 and the August report September 16, 2026; both current archive PDFs were reviewed on October 15. This supports periodic reconciliation over the sole disclosed native issuance population, not continuous whole-supply controls or an assurance opinion. At the August snapshot, slot 443168735, total issued supply was 8,177,042 tokens; 467,883.071866 management-designated treasury tokens and ZAR467,883.07 of reserve allocation were excluded, leaving ZAR7,944,582.89 against 7,709,158.928134 circulating tokens and reported coverage of 103.05%. Treasury classification and reserve attribution are management representations, not technical transfer locks or independently verified bank-level segregation. The current archive publishes distinct November and December 2025 and January through August 2026 PDF links; the prior repeated-link caveat no longer describes that archive. The fresh pinned mint supply remains 8,177,042, while the report's treasury account now contains 309,559.939154 tokens; neither observation refreshes the August bank balances or establishes a complete current non-circulating census. The production on-chain-total-supply fallback values issued tokens in USD and is not the report's historical circulation denominator. Current direct app redemption remains future-only under binding terms; exchange prices, liquidity and settlement are not guaranteed. Historical pool depth, volume and short chart observations are not current measurements. Legal trust, bankruptcy priority, token-issuance-specific prudential supervision and exact mint-key human independence remain unproved. None of these qualifications leaves an unidentified native mint authority.

scopedQuestions.question: Issuer and Fireblocks disclosures establish MPC custody for ZARsc Solana issuance, but do not identify the beneficial human signing operators, their organizational independence, or the approval-policy boundary for the exact ordinary mint signer UuicDY26j4dUf5QraXJ99PwPzGwZjRWZmnxcyMhJAgk. Which people and approval policy govern this key? MPC key-share separation does not itself establish independent humans; the on-chain account still enforces neither a multisig quorum nor a timelock.
